The '''Twelfth Army''', also known as '''Cerulean Spear Command''', was a [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Republic]] and later [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] [[Sector Army/Legends|Sector Army]] charged with the defense of the [[Maldrood Oversector/Legends|Maldrood Oversector]].<ref name="TEGTW" />

During the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]] between [[21 BBY/Legends|21 BBY]] and [[19 BBY/Legends|19 BBY]], Cerulean Spear was charged with invading and controlling the Separatist enclave on the Outer [[Perlemian Trade Route/Legends|Perlemian]], which included many of the Confederacy's most productive and best-defended industrial worlds. With Sector 3 reinforcing its Coreward positions, Cerulean Spear had advanced early from its secure rear base at Lantillies to [[Battle of Centares (Clone Wars)|Centares]]. It also played a major role during the [[Outer Rim Sieges/Legends|Outer Rim Sieges]].<ref name="TEGTW" />

During the [[Reconquest of the Rim]] between 19 BBY and [[17 BBY/Legends|17 BBY]], Cerulean Spear Command was relocated to [[Charros IV/Legends|Charros]] during the [[Sy Myrthian Insurrection]], where the group ground down [[Senator/Legends|Senator]] [[Toonbuck Toora/Legends|Toonbuck Toora's]] forces after several months of fighting, as well as winning [[Diado]] and [[Metalorn/Legends|Metalorn]] and besieging [[Sy Myrth/Legends|Sy Myrth]], before eventually having the [[Praetor-class Star Battlecruiser/Legends|''Praetor''-class Star Battlecruiser]] [[Battalion (Praetor-class)|''Battalion'']] chase down and eventually wipe out Toora and her fleet.<ref name="TEGTW" />
